subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

After I shut the door and started back to the living room, / he yelled something at me, / but I couldn't strictly hear him.

options.text: but I couldn't strictly hear him.
After I shut the door and started back to the living room,

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the adverb "**strictly**" in part 3.
 
• The word "**strictly**" is incorrect in this context and should be replaced with "**clearly**" to convey the intended meaning.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**but I couldn't clearly hear him**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"After I shut the door and started back to the living room, he yelled something at me, but I couldn't **clearly **__hear him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: No error** – This would be correct if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
 
• **Option 2: he yelled something at me** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: but I couldn't strictly hear him.** – **This part contains the error as explained above.**
 
• **Option 4: After I shut the door and started back to the living room** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
